entries.name: CNSS family benefits 10,03 % and work accidents 2,25 % (employer, up to 600 000 F a month)
entries.statute: Loi n° 47-2024 (LF 2025) art. 9 (CNSS employer total 20,28 %, read); branch split and ceilings from CLEISS 'Les cotisations au Congo' (1 Jan 2023, R4/fetch/cleiss11/congo.html)
entries.doc: LF 2025 art. 9: CNSS 'cotisations patronales : 20,28 %'. CLEISS: prestations familiales 10,03 % and accidents du travail 2,25 % (employer only) up to 600 000 FCFA a month; pensions 8 % employer up to 1 200 000 FCFA (10,03 + 2,25 + 8 = 20,28).
unsupported: branch split and ceilings from a secondary table dated 2023 (flag)
State takeover for newly declared informal employers (art. 9 al. 2)

entries.name: CAMU (universal health insurance) employer contribution (4,55 %, up to 600 000 F a month)
entries.statute: Loi n° 47-2024 (LF 2025) art. 9 (rate); ceiling 600 000 FCFA a month from CLEISS (2023)
entries.doc: LF 2025 art. 9: 'pour la caisse d'assurance maladie universelle : cotisations patronales : 4,55 % ; cotisations de l'employé : 2,27 %'. CLEISS: RAMU 4,55 % / 2,27 % up to 600 000 FCFA a month.

entries.name: CNSS pensions, employer share (8 %, up to 1 200 000 F a month)
entries.statute: Loi n° 47-2024 (LF 2025) art. 9; ceiling from CLEISS 'Les cotisations au Congo' (2023)
entries.doc: See the CNSS family/work-accident entry: pensions 8 % employer / 4 % employee, monthly ceiling 1 200 000 FCFA (CLEISS); the LF 2025 total of 20,28 % includes this 8 %.
unsupported: the employee's 4 % (LF 2025 prints 4,55 % for the employee: the 1.x PIT side is unchanged)

entries.name: Fonds national de construction 2 % and ACPE/FONEA 0,5 % (employer, up to 1 200 000 F a month)
entries.statute: CLEISS 'Les cotisations au Congo' (1 Jan 2023); the instruments (CGI tome 1, ACPE texts) not read [text version: CLEISS edition 'au 1er janvier 2023', the latest edition held (no 2025 edition reached: flag)]
entries.doc: CLEISS: 'Fonds National de construction 2 % ... 1 200 000 FCFA'; 'Agence Congolaise pour l'Emploi (ACPE) et Fonds National d'Appui à l'Employabilité et l'Apprentissage (FONEA) (y compris la taxe d'apprentissage de 1 % retenue par les contributions directes) 0,5 % ... 1 200 000 FCFA'.
unsupported: taxe d'apprentissage 1 % (collected by the tax administration) not modelled: rate and base not read in the CGI
taxe unique sur les salaires: not checked

entries.name: Taxe sur les véhicules de tourisme des sociétés (annual: 200 000 F up to 9 CV, 500 000 F above)
entries.statute: CGI tome 1 (finances.gouv.cg edition; edition date not established), world/B08-central-africa-fr/cg/law/cgi_tome1.txt l. 5001-5050 art. 171-A to 171-G (art. 171-F: Loi n° 05/96 du 2 mars 1996). The finance laws held (Journal officiel special editions 2022-2025 incl. LF 2025, Loi n° 47-2024) contain no amendment of art. 171-A to 171-G (searched); B as the code edition is undated
entries.doc: art. 171-F: 'deux cent mille (200.000) francs par voiture imposable dont la puissance est inférieure ou égale à 09 CV, et 500.000 francs par voiture imposable dont la puissance est supérieure à 09 CV'; art. 171-D: cars first put into circulation more than 10 years before 1 January exempt; art. 171-E: annual, 1 January - 31 December. Households: the communal taxe sur les véhicules à moteur (art. 355-359) at rates fixed by municipal deliberation (art. 358), not modelled (nil tariff here). Worked case (hand): a company with cars of 9 and 12 CV -> 200 000 + 500 000 = 700 000. Sixteenth pass.
unsupported: exemption of cars first put into circulation more than 10 years before (art. 171-D): age not read by this family (cars taken as younger)
communal taxe sur les véhicules à moteur (CGI art. 355-358): rate fixed by each municipal council, not modelled
commercial vehicles (voitures commerciales) outside the tax
